    def test_mutating_padding_input(self):
        """
        Even if `aten.constant_pad_nd` input get inplace updated,
        doing inplace-padding still generates the correct result.
        """
    
        def f(x, y):
            x2 = aten.constant_pad_nd(x, (0, 8, 0, 0), 12345.0)
            x.add_(5)
            return x2 @ y

            (M, N), (N + 10, 1)
        )
